summary.name: Sketchbook
summary.one_liner: Sketchbook is sketching, painting, and illustration software for drawing from quick sketches to finished artwork across desktop and mobile devices.
use_cases: precise drawing with guides and rulers
summary.what_it_does: Sketchbook provides drawing, sketching, and painting tools aimed at both casual sketching and professional illustration. Its brushes and pens are designed to behave like physical art tools. The interface can hide tools and palettes until needed to keep focus on the drawing. Customizable brushes are supported by guides, rulers, and stroke tools for precision. Layers offer a full set of blend modes for building up drawings and color.
notable: Brushes and pens designed to behave like physical counterparts
Customizable brushes with guides, rulers, and stroke tools
Layers with full set of blend modes
Clean interface with tools and palettes that can be hidden
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware, which is not confirmed by the page text
